name: CodeApex
description: CodeApex is a bilingual benchmark dataset designed to evaluate large language models' programming comprehension, code generation, and code correction abilities. It includes multiple-choice questions on programming concepts, code completion tasks in C++, and real-world code correction challenges.
reputation: A specialized code benchmark from the literature that has seen some use in code understanding and correction evaluation, but is not among the most widely standardized coding leaderboards.
notes: Evaluates multiple programming abilities of LLMs; includes bilingual data and real-world error correction.
